name: mob-object-pool-cap
summary: Zone.exe pre-sizes the mob object pool at 8000 per process and gives kind 5 exactly 8000 handles; past that every spawn is refused with 'MobBreeder::mb_regen : Too many mob'. Raise the pool to 12000 - the mob handle range the 2026 client uses - with the same six constants as the NPC recipe.
status: BUILT 2026-09-23. Boot on one zone, then everywhere (operator rule).
why: Operator P0, 2026-09-22: 'raise the 8k mob limit' - a recipe instead of moving maps between zones. Zone 1 of the
2026on2016 stack reached 8,530 regen mobs once the fitted 2026 spawn groups landed (a 2016 zone peaks at 6,544)
and MobBreeder::mb_regen asserted 'Too many mob' 26 times a second; the fields keep growing with every capture.
The mob pool is the same shape as the NPC one (npc-object-pool-cap, NOTES-object-handles.md), factory type 5,
pool at manager+0x10C, mob objects 0x2568 bytes each:
0x005576D0  push 0x1F40                 ; ShineObjectPool::Create element count (manager ctor)
0x0055C9BD  push 0x0490F204             ; operator new bytes for the object array: 8000 * 0x2568 + 4
0x0055C9DF  push 0x1F40                 ; eh vector ctor element count
0x0055C9ED  mov  dword [eax], 0x1F40    ; array cookie, read by the dtor
0x0055CAB4  cmp  eax, 0x17700           ; fill loop bound in SLOT BYTES: 8000 * 12
0x00548E07  mov  edx, 0x1F40 ; cmp dx, ax ; ja compose ; else 0xFFFF   sohu_SetMobHandle (maker A)
0x00556A51  mov  ecx, 0x1F40 ; cmp cx, ax ; ja compose ; else 0xFFFF   ShineMob::so_RemakeHandle (maker B)
0x00633656  mov  ecx, 0x1F40 ; cmp cx, ax ; jbe next   sohu_HandleSplit: handle < 0x1F40 -> kind 5, index = handle
Mobs are kind 5 with base 0, so no handle COMPOSITION site carries a base to move; only the split's upper bound
and the two makers' span checks grow with the pool.
WHY 12000 AND WHY THIS NEEDS handle-layout-2026. The 2026 client splits handles by its own literal ranges:
mobs 0x0000-0x2EE0 (12000), players from 0x2EE0. handle-layout-2026 already moved the zone's player base to
0x2EE0 (sohu_SetPlayerHandle 0x548E49 and ShinePlayer::so_RemakeHandle 0x559D71) and left 0x1F40-0x2EE0
unassigned. This recipe hands exactly that gap to the mobs, so the zone's mob range becomes the client's. With
the STOCK layout (players from 0x1F40) a 12000-mob pool would compose player handles inside the mob range; the
two player_base edits below are no-op writes that REFUSE to apply unless the player base is 0x2EE0 already.
Raising 'mobs' past 0x2EE0 needs the player range moved first, and the client would not follow anyway.
MEMORY. 4000 more mob objects * 0x2568 B = 37 MB per zone process, allocated at start-up.
NOT TOUCHED. RaidSystem::CreateRaid / ResetRaid write 0x1E80 and 0x1F40 as raid handle values (its own id space,
compared only inside RaidSystem::FindRaid); the raid system's 2016 behaviour is unchanged. AbnormalState buffers
of 0x1F40 bytes and the 0x1F40-byte item/quest save buffers are unrelated uses of the same number.
HOW TO PROVE IT: a zone hosting > 8000 regen mobs (make_stack without the MOVES that spread zone 1 out, or
integrate_harvest --deploy's per-zone regen count) boots with no 'Too many mob' in its Assert log, and
tools/zone_npcpool_probe.pl (Fiesta2026on2016) reads pool +0x10C with 12000 slots, all carrying an object.

edits.why: manager ctor: mob pool element count
som_Initialize: operator new bytes for the mob object array (mobs * 0x2568 + 4)
som_Initialize: eh vector ctor element count
som_Initialize: fill loop bound in slot bytes (mobs * 12)
GUARD: the player base must already be 0x2EE0 (handle-layout-2026) - sohu_SetPlayerHandle
GUARD: the player base must already be 0x2EE0 (handle-layout-2026) - ShinePlayer::so_RemakeHandle
